decision: The narrow host committed-blob comparison correction is accepted. No unresolved blocking issue was found. The manifest continues to authenticate exact actual source bytes; only Git's independently attested CRLF-to-LF representation difference is admitted when comparing those bytes with committed blobs. All original preexecution and runtime conditions remain mandatory.
why_correction_is_needed: Read-only Git inspection of protected api/services/amd_geometry_assets.py showed index LF, working-tree CRLF, unspecified text/filter/working-tree-encoding/ident/eol attributes and core.autocrlf=true. Protected working bytes must remain unchanged. The former unconditional raw blob equality could refuse this already-normalized Git representation before any launch.
reviewed_alternate_acceptance: Exact blob/working-byte equality remains the first acceptance branch.
The alternate branch requires at least one CRLF, replaces only CRLF with LF, refuses any remaining CR and requires the resulting bytes to equal the committed blob exactly.
Git must report i/lf and w/crlf. Text must be unspecified, auto or set; filter, working-tree-encoding and ident must all be unspecified; core.autocrlf must equal true.

Candidate manifest hashes still bind the unmodified actual files, and validate_committed still checks exact HEAD identity and clean candidate paths. No arbitrary content difference, filter transform, runtime-source exception or source rewrite is added.
regression_review: The directly relevant CPU regression was reviewed as source only. It covers the admitted CRLF/LF case; ordinary content changes, stray CR and other byte differences; wrong EOL metadata; foreign filter, -text or ident transformation; autocrlf=false; and unchanged exact bytes without Git metadata calls. The reviewer did not run tests.
receipt_relationship: The earlier independent-preexecution-review.json and independent-final-manifest-review.json remain historical receipts for their recorded hashes. This additive receipt approves the narrow host/test correction and records the refreshed final manifest. The unchanged worker and all earlier execution/ownership/resource/cleanup acceptance findings remain applicable.
